units.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control
units.label: Art. 15.6

units.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control
units.text: 1. Failure to submit to tax authorities or customs authorities, within the time limit established by legislation on taxes and levies, duly completed documents and (or) other information necessary for tax control, or refusal to submit them, or submission of such information in an incomplete or distorted form, except in the cases provided for in Part 2 of this Article, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.6

units.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred to three hundred roubles; on officials, three hundred to five hundred roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.6 · “shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred…”

units.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control
units.text: 2. Violation by an official of a state body, local self-government body, organisation, diplomatic mission or consular institution, or by a notary, of the time limits prescribed by the legislation of the Russian Federation on taxes and levies for submitting (communicating) to tax authorities information relating to the registration of organisations and individuals, or submission of such information in an incomplete or distorted form —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15.6

units.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15.6 · “shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one…”
